raw_segments.text: Macbeth, be innocent of the knowledge dearest Chuck till thou applaud the deed. Come, ceiling
night scarf up the tender eye of pitiful day, and with thy bloody and invisible hand cancel
and tear to pieces that great bond which keeps me pale. Light thickens, and the crow makes
wing to T.H. rookie wood. Good things of day begin to droop and drowse, while's nights
black agents to their praise do rouse. Thou marvels't at my words, but hold thee still,
things bad begun make strong themselves by ill. So, P. R. I. Thee, go with me.
